claims: Tool reads the entire C-file and suggests which VA disability claims to file and what the evidence is
Demo: uploaded 38 pages of a redacted C-file (entrance + exit exam w/ handwritten notes); tool found right shoulder injury, plantar fasciitis, nearsightedness, hearing loss, glaucoma
'View source documents' links each finding to the page (e.g. plantar fasciitis on page 38; pre-existing note on pages 39-41)
Tool distinguishes direct vs aggravation (pre-existing plantar fasciitis made worse in service) vs secondary service connection
Processing takes 12 to 96 hours because Veteran AI runs its own servers for privacy and the analysis is expensive (2,000-4,000 page files)
After analysis you can select a condition and 'Create Disabilities' to start gathering evidence
how_to_steps: Log in to Veteran AI (annual plan required) and open C File Analysis
Upload your C-file (creator uploaded a 38-page redacted sample)
Review conditions found in service treatment records; click 'View Source Documents' to jump to the cited page
Note the service-connection theory per condition (direct / aggravation / secondary)
Select the condition and click 'Create Disabilities' to start the claim/evidence workflow
on_screen_only: Template graphic: 'How This New Tool Analyzes Your C File for VA Disability Claims'

Veteran AI UI cards: Right Shoulder Injury, Plantar Fasciitis, Near Sighted, Glaucoma (Early Indicators), Hearing Loss, each with 'View Source Documents'; summary row showing '~7 months' and '$3,5xx+' (estimated timeline / monthly benefit)

Static sidebar '100% Disabled Veterans': 1 Property Taxes Exemption (state specific), 2 Ch. 35 DEA (Dependents Education Assistance, up to 36 months), 3 CHAMPVA for dependents, 4 Federal Student Loan Forgiveness (100% P&T or TDIU), 5 Special Adapted Housing (SAH) grant up to $117K

'VA Disability Claim Timeline' strip: Claim is received > Initial review > Gathering of evidence > Preparation for the decision > Pending decision approval > Preparation for notification > Claim complete
Creator wears 'Tinnitus' hoodie; watermark '...Solutions' site header

relevance.why: Personally relevant as a veteran with VA claims (C-file review, aggravation theory). As a builder it is a reference competitor/example of a document-analysis RAG product with page-level citations and a long async processing queue.

implement_score.why: Not a workflow tool. Personal action: consider trying it on own C-file if cost is reasonable. Product idea: the 'cite the exact page' + 'service-connection theory' pattern is replicable with Claude and PDF chunking for any evidence-heavy domain.
